en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 640 points, back under 24,000
en.dek: The index finished at 23,972 after a holiday-delayed session, with AIA, Standard Chartered and HSBC leading the fall.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed on Friday at 23,972, down 640 points, or 2.6 per cent, ending back below 24,000 for the first time in more than two months, according to market reports of the official close.

The index opened 513 points lower at 24,099 and fell as much as about 748 points to a session low of 23,865 before settling. The Hang Seng China Enterprises Index closed at 8,030, down 189 points, or 2.3 per cent. The Hang Seng Tech Index finished at 4,157, down 95 points, or 2.3 per cent. Turnover was HK$145.8 billion, with Stock Connect northbound trading absent for the holiday.

Financials led the decline. Sing Tao reported AIA down 6 per cent at HK$69.20, a near one-year low; Standard Chartered down 6 per cent at HK$229.80; and HSBC down 5.4 per cent at HK$149.50, below HK$150. BOC Hong Kong fell 3 per cent to HK$50.70. Market commentary linked the move to a global bond sell-off and higher long-term yields.

For the week, the Hang Seng was down 538 points, or 2.2 per cent, a fourth straight weekly loss, the same reports said. The morning session had already been down about 2.6 per cent; the close confirmed the full-day fall.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌640點 失守二萬四
zh.dek: 假期後首個交易日恒指收報23972點，友邦、渣打及滙控領跌，全日成交1458億元。
body: 港股星期五收市，恒生指數報23972點，跌640點或2.6%，相隔逾兩個月再度失守24000點，市場報道引述收市數據如此。
恒指低開513點，開報24099點，盤中最多曾跌約748點，低見23865點。國企指數收報8030點，跌189點或2.3%；科指收報4157點，跌95點或2.3%。北水假期缺席，全日成交1458億元。
金融股拖累大市。《星島》報道，友邦跌6%，收報69.2元，見近一年低位；渣打亦跌6%，收報229.8元；滙控跌5.4%，收報149.5元，跌穿150元。中銀香港跌3%，收報50.7元。市場評論將跌勢與環球債市拋售及長債息上升一併提及。
以一周計，恒指累跌538點或2.2%，連跌四周。早段已曾下跌約2.6%，收市確認全日跌幅。
